title: DSWD releases P677.8M in aid to over 66,000 Negros sugar workers

blocks.text: BACOLOD CITY — The Department of Social Welfare and Development (DSWD) has disbursed P677.8 million in assistance to more than 66,000 small sugarcane farmers and laborers affected by the red-striped soft scale insect infestation across the Negros Island Region, DSWD-NIR Regional Director Arwin Razo said Monday, Oct. 26. Data from the DSWD Disaster Response Operations Monitoring and Information Center (DROMIC) as of Oct. 24 showed that the agency’s Uplift Disaster Assistance Program had provided financial assistance to 66,005 beneficiaries, comprising 56,301 sugarcane farmers and 9,704 sugarcane laborers.
